sections.text: What is known about the step after this walkthrough, so the boundary is a handover rather than a cliff. Transfer Order Planning (cppat1210m000) turns a planned order into a real one — production orders into Job Shop Control, purchase orders into Procurement — and the purchase half was walked on 2026-08-25: two planned purchase orders for BAM-ROD became one purchase order. Full reference in the source on file. Three things from that walk matter to anyone leaving this walkthrough:

tokens.v: A purchased component will not transfer without buy-from business partner data.
The transfer fails and prints
"Buy-from BP cannot be determined for item … ; neither valid Item - BP data is present, nor a BP is linked to Item Purchase Data."
The fix is a row on the
Item - Business Partner
tab of the item's purchase data.
Nothing in this walkthrough's phases surfaces this
, because a planned purchase order is generated happily without it — the gap only appears at transfer.
Not documented for this release.

sections.text: - A purchased component will not transfer without buy-from business partner data. The transfer fails and prints "Buy-from BP cannot be determined for item … ; neither valid Item - BP data is present, nor a BP is linked to Item Purchase Data." The fix is a row on the Item - Business Partner tab of the item's purchase data. Nothing in this walkthrough's phases surfaces this, because a planned purchase order is generated happily without it — the gap only appears at transfer. Not documented for this release.
